fields.label: Description
fields.value:
'Matariki Festival' - Celebrate Māori New Year. Including Kapa Haka Super 12s (Queens Wharf, July 14), 'The Revival' / Chris Molloy (Mangere Arts Centre, June 27 - 30), 'Stars of Matariki, featuring Annie Crummer, Betty-Anne Monga, Maisey Rika, Ria Hall (Telstra Clear Pacific Islands Centre, Manukau, June 23), 'Kanikani' by the Atamira Dance Company; Festival held in Auckland. June 21 - July 21, 2012 (programme)

'From Flax to Fibre Exhibition. Honouring the life and legacy of Emily Schuster (1927-1997). Part of the Matariki Festival. Held at Auckland Central Library. 2012 (programme)

'Toi Oho' - Celebrating the Māori New Year at libraries across Auckland. Booklet of events occurring in Auckland libraries for Matariki Festival. June 22 - July 21, 2012 (15 page A5 booklet, coaster)

'Matariki on the Waterfront'. Featuring Anika Moa, Ria Hall, Lewis McCallum, Anna Coddington. July 21, 2012 (A6 colour flyer)

'Matariki' - Māori New Year. Pathfinder to Māori information at Auckland Libraries. Presented by Auckland Libraries. 2012 (leaflet)

'Matariki Festival' - Celebrate Māori New Year. Held in Auckland. June 22 - July 22, 2013 (programme)

'Matariki' - A Programme of New Zealand Music. Presented by Ensemble Polymnia. Conducted by Sarah Bisley. Including Charlotte Fetherston (viola). Performed at the Holy Trinity Church, 20 Church Street, Devonport. May 12, 2013 (A5 flyer)

'Matariki Dawn' - Planetarium Show. Presented by the Stardome Observatory, Auckland. June 26 - 30, 2013 (A4 poster)

'Te Mara o te Po - The Night Garden'. Part of the Matariki Festival. Including Mihirangi, Balcksanddiva, Jay Okesene and the Dubtronics, Huia Hamon. Performed at the Corban Estate Arts Centre, Great North Road, Henderson, Auckland. July 6, 2013 (A4 poster)

'2013 Matariki and Māori Art Coin'. Stamp and coin editions by New Zealand Post. 2013 (leaflet)

'Family Kite Flying Fun' - New Zealand Post Manu Aute Kite Day. Held at Orakei Marae, Auckland. July 20, 2013 (A4 poster)
